# Devobi LLC

> Devobi reactivates the dormant leads already in your CRM. AI writes personalized
> follow-ups to old quotes and cold inquiries, verifies the replies, and books
> qualified estimates straight onto your calendar — with no new ad spend.

Devobi is an AI lead reactivation service for home service contractors: roofers,
HVAC companies, solar installers, and plumbers.

## Core offering
- **AI Lead Reactivation** — personalized AI-written follow-ups to dormant CRM leads.
- **Home Services CRM Integration** — ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Jobber, FieldEdge,
  Service Fusion, HubSpot, Salesforce. Nothing to migrate.
- **Lead Follow-Up & Qualification** — inbound replies are read and sorted so you know
  instantly which old leads are worth calling back.
- **Appointment Booking Automation** — qualified replies become booked estimates on your calendar.
- **Free 14-Day Pilot** — hand over your 500 coldest leads; get at least 3 qualified
  responses in 14 days or pay nothing. No contracts, no setup fees. You keep every
  lead we reactivate.
